subject: Implement FastMCP server with lifespan management
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/server.py` with FastMCP server setup and connection pool lifespan.

Must implement:
- FastMCP server instance with `name="mamba-mcp-hana"`
- Lifespan context manager that:
  1. Creates and initializes the connection pool on startup
  2. Tests the connection (fail-fast if HANA is unreachable)
  3. Stores pool reference in server context for tool access
  4. Disposes all connections on shutdown
- Support for stdio and HTTP transports (configurable via settings)
- Logging setup: JSON or text format, configurable level, output to stderr
- `create_server(config)` factory function that wires everything together

Reference: mamba-mcp-postgres `server.py` for the FastMCP lifespan pattern.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] FastMCP server created with correct name and description
- [ ] Lifespan initializes pool, tests connection, stores in context
- [ ] Lifespan disposes pool on shutdown
- [ ] Server supports both stdio and HTTP transport modes
- [ ] Logging configured per settings (format, level, stderr)

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] HANA unreachable on startup: fails fast with clear error message
- [ ] Graceful shutdown during active queries: waits for completion

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Startup connection failure: logged and re-raised with guidance

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Lifespan initializes and disposes pool correctly (mocked)
• Unit: Server creation with different transport configs
• Unit: Fail-fast behavior when connection test fails

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 9.1, 7.1
